charge_port.notes: Rivian: "All 2026+ Rivian vehicles have a built-in NACS charge port" (CCS1 adapter for CCS stations).

supercharger_access.notes: Rivian: 2026+ NACS port charges at Tesla Superchargers (over 21,000 sites in North America).

wheels.notes: KBB: the 2026 R1T standard was 22 inch (R1T only). R1S assumed the same; no source states the R1S standard. SlashGear's 2025 'entry-level 20 inch' and KBB's 2026 '22 inch standard' differ and CARB states neither, so this is unresolved.
CARB 2026 lists the R1S Dual Large in 20 inch road and 20 inch all-terrain configurations.
